eps_ref_source: T1 patch-off smp arms (same seeds and action seed, deterministic bit-equal finals)

kernel.cap_behaviour: silent for the rest of the run once the cap is hit; consumption recorded
kernel.rationale: v2 receipts: the local repair is always accepted but once-per-run timing drowns in trajectory noise; v3-v6: one-shot restarts never write back; v7 aggregates the proven repair at visit scale (FEA/OCC periodic shared-variable synchronization)
kernel.recipe: v2 three-point quadratic re-centering (0.25*span probes, interior vertex, strict-best only) applied after EVERY stateful visit of a certified-owner block
kernel.selection: deterministic schedule over T0-certified links; no classifier, no online selection signal, no cross-visit state
